slides.title: Look for 1976 on.
slides.body: Front disc brakes on top of the 2F six and four-speed. Owners call 1978 the coveted year.

slides.title: Look for 1993–97.
slides.body: The 4.5 L 1FZ-FE six, bigger brakes and optional front and rear lockers.

slides.title: Look for 2003–07.
slides.body: The five-speed automatic. Skip 1998–99 if you wheel hard: the two-pinion front diff is the weak one.

slides.title: Look for 2013 on.
slides.body: The facelift made Multi-Terrain Select, Multi-Terrain Monitor and Off-Road Turn Assist standard.
